name: Elohe Leon
source:
A brave and renouned fiend slayer. Plus, his reputation and wealth are not the only things that made his perfect image, as you can see he is also fantastically handsome.

In the story, he is possessed by the slime who enjoy his new and powerful role, but also uses his stolen and attractive body to satisfy his sexual hunger. While being possessed, Leon lost his loyalty, honesty and his notion of good and evil. Also, Slime/Leon  is a deceptive sexual beast.
